activity_summary: In the long room you bowed to an empty chair, once. Sam had done it four times and was corrected. The Master left Pope's Nurse standing, took forty lines out of a lament over a girl who is not dead, and you were annoyed because the shorter act was better. A yeoman lent two cloaks, Prince and Paris, to be returned on Innocents' night and counted. Nick was heard under the note and was not lifted. The Master signed the three Richmond books and said nothing of the king. Bryan put nine of the clock, after supper, and the bow, onto the tables.

quotes.text: In a presence chamber, lads, you bow to the chair even when the chair is empty.

quotes.speaker: edmund_tilney
quotes.text: Her Majesty was nursed. Leave it.

quotes.speaker: edmund_tilney
quotes.text: It is a pretty play. The fourth act is prettiest where it is shortest.
